title: Azure Activity Log: the audit trail, and answering "who did this?"

videos.script: Something in the subscription changed, and nobody remembers doing it. {{nobody}} Azure remembers. Every request that changes a resource passes through Resource Manager, and Resource Manager writes it down: what, who, from where, and whether it worked. {{log}} That record is the activity log. It is kept for ninety days, unless you keep it longer. {{days}} This lesson answers three who-did-this questions from it, then keeps it for a year and alerts on the changes that matter most. {{end}}
